curve_fitting.message.validating.zh: 校验 {{files}} 个 CSV 文件

curve_fitting.message.done.zh: 曲线拟合完成，共 {{files}} 个文件

curve_fitting.message.below_min_nonzero.zh: {{name}}：{{count}} 个特征的非零观测少于 {{min_nonzero}} 个，未拟合：{{features}}
curve_fitting.message.below_min_nonzero.en: {{name}}: {{count}} features have fewer than {{min_nonzero}} nonzero observations and were not fitted: {{features}}

funclu.message.loaded.zh: 已载入 {{conditions}} 个条件、{{features}} 个共享特征的观测值（quasi_dynamic）
funclu.message.loaded.en: Loaded the observations (quasi_dynamic) of {{features}} shared features in {{conditions}} conditions

funclu.message.bic_done.zh: BIC 扫描完成（{{k_count}} 个 K × {{model_count}} 种协方差结构），推荐 {{model}} · K = {{best}}
funclu.message.bic_done.en: BIC scan finished ({{k_count}} K values × {{model_count}} covariance structures); recommended {{model}}, K = {{best}}

funclu.message.bic_boundary_upper.zh: 推荐的 K = {{k}} 是本次扫描的最大 K，BIC 可能还没到最低点；建议增大 k_max 后重新扫描。
funclu.message.bic_boundary_upper.en: The recommended K = {{k}} is the largest K scanned, so BIC may not have reached its minimum. Increase k_max and scan again.

funclu.message.bic_boundary_lower.zh: 推荐的 K = {{k}} 是本次扫描的最小 K，BIC 可能还没到最低点；建议减小 k_min 后重新扫描。
funclu.message.bic_boundary_lower.en: The recommended K = {{k}} is the smallest K scanned, so BIC may not have reached its minimum. Decrease k_min and scan again.

funclu.message.bic_min_size_violated.zh: 没有候选模型满足最小簇大小 {{min_size}}，推荐的是不受该约束时 BIC 最低的模型。
funclu.message.bic_min_size_violated.en: No candidate meets the minimum cluster size of {{min_size}}; the recommendation is the lowest-BIC model without that constraint.
